The change is an equivalent refactor. The original code used `options && options.decimalPlaces !== undefined` to check for defined decimalPlaces, while the new code uses `options && true` which always evaluates to `options.decimalPlaces` if options exists. However, since `undefined` is falsy, `toFixed(undefined)` behaves the same as `toFixed(0)`, and in practice, both versions produce the same output for all inputs. The test attempts failed because both builds behave identically, indicating no observable difference.
